changelog: Turn user-supplied risk-grade definitions into a four-to-eight still risk grade set.

en.description: Turn user-supplied risk-grade definitions into a four-to-eight still risk grade set. This risk grade still studio lays out each named grade as its own still. Use it for risk grade graphics, risk level cards, risk classification stills, and a risk grade pack.

en.title: Risk Grade Set: Risk Level Cards and Grade Stills
